title: WGI governance proxy v1 source recipe

official_sources.release: WGI 2025 Revision: Governance Estimates and Absolute Scores (1996-2024)
official_sources.citation: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators Data Catalog entry.
official_sources.selection_rule: Use 2024 country/economy rows from all six official WGI sheets; derive the project proxy only when Government Effectiveness and Rule of Law scores both exist.

official_dimensions.political_stability: Political Stability and Absence of Violence/Terrorism

project_defined_metrics.wgi_state_capacity_composite_0_100: Mean of Government Effectiveness and Rule of Law when both source scores are observed.

runtime_selection.method: Official 2024 scores for all six WGI dimensions passed through on the 0-100 scale; modern_world uses geographic country codes, while supported historical scenarios use baseline owner reference mapping; no project composite or historical measurement.

historical_reference_policy.join_method: Baseline owner tag -> scenarioCountriesByTag[tag].base_iso2 (explicit two-letter ISO2) -> existing ISO2-to-ISO3 mapping -> official WGI country/economy score.
historical_reference_policy.unknown_mapping_policy: Leave unmapped owners blank; do not infer from tags, parent countries, or modern feature geography.
historical_reference_policy.interpretation: 2024 governance reference values mapped to scenario baseline owners; not observed governance measurements for historical years.

missing_value_policy: Missing or unavailable source values stay null and carry source_gap or partial_source_gap status.
uncertainty_policy: Preserve WGI number of sources, standard errors, and 90% confidence intervals for source metrics; do not infer composite uncertainty.
